note:
A CAUSAL head-dim-128 SDPA folded on the tensor cores. SDPA's mask traces as a coordinate `Select` over the query row and the key column, added to the score inside the twisted carrier's own prefix, and the chunk tier refused the whole target over it twice: the mask's fill / zero constants are a computed operand with no gmem address, and the `Select` itself was no straight-line statement. So every masked attention target fell to the scalar tier — `attention.hd256.dynM.pv` on the RTX 4090 golden is the recorded row that stopped decoding.

The prefix's leaves are read ONCE ahead of the chunk loop, so they need no slab; the `Select` is per element and lands at fragment residence as a `FragmentMask`, the same coordinate substitution the boundary mask already performs.

attrs.body:
let f32 v0 = 0.0883883461356163
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_fill_c[0]
in1 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_zero_c[0]
for a0 in 0..8:
    for a1 in 0..512:
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in2 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                in3 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a3]
                f32 v1 = multiply(in2, in3)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a3
            v2 = multiply(acc1, v0)
            v3 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v4 = add(v3, v2)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v4) over a2
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in4 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                in5 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a5]
                f32 v5 = multiply(in4, in5)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v5) over a5
            v6 = multiply(acc3, v0)
            v7 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v8 = add(v7, v6)
            v9 = subtract(v8, acc0)
            v10 = exp(v9)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v10) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..512:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in6 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    in7 = load x1[0, a0, a7, a8]
                    f32 v11 = multiply(in6, in7)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v11) over a8
                v12 = multiply(acc5, v0)
                in8 = load x2[0, a0, a7, a6]
                v13 = select:
                    in1 when a7 <= a1
                    in0 when a1 < a7
                v14 = add(v13, v12)
                v15 = subtract(v14, acc0)
                v16 = exp(v15)
                v17 = divide(v16, acc2)
                v18 = multiply(in8, v17)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v18) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
